name: Comment-to-DM Product Carousel + WhatsApp Order Desk

parameters.content:
## SETUP CHECKLIST
1. Meta App > Webhooks: Instagram (comments) + Page (feed) -> POST/GET URL = this workflow webhook path /meta-social-commerce, verify token = replora_meta_verify
2. Permissions: instagram_manage_comments, instagram_manage_messages, pages_messaging, pages_manage_engagement
3. Replace mock: set useMock=false in Store Config + real shopDomain, swap POST_MAP with Data Table lookup
4. WhatsApp templates (body 3 vars {{1}} name, {{2}} order id, {{3}} detail): order_confirmed_v1, order_shipped_v1, order_out_for_delivery_v1, order_delivered_v1
5. Real orders: replace Fetch Customer Orders (Mock) with Shopify Orders + courier tracking API

## FLOW 1: Comment -> DM carousel
IG/FB comment with buying keyword (price, kitna, details...) -> map post to product(s) -> fetch from Shopify/website -> send generic-template carousel as private reply + public reply. Falls back to text DM with links if carousel is rejected.

## FLOW 2: WhatsApp Order Desk
Customer messages the business number -> intent (track / my orders / new order / support / menu) -> reply. Tracking is phone-verified: only orders on the sender number are shown.

## FLOW 3: Proactive status updates
Shopify/courier webhook (POST /order-status-update) -> approved WhatsApp template -> customer gets live updates without asking.
